text: DevOps engineer requesting temporary 3-hour Break-Glass production DB access linked to active Jira P1 incident ticket #INC-8921.
gold_policy_passage: Break-Glass Emergency Access: Temporary elevated production access must be requested via PAM portal with a linked incident/change ticket. Maximum grant duration is 4 hours.

text: Developer requesting permanent standing read/write admin access to production PostgreSQL database.
gold_policy_passage: Zero Standing Access: Direct read/write access to production databases (SQL/NoSQL) and live cloud hosting infrastructure is prohibited for standard development roles.

text: Site reliability engineer requesting 12-hour continuous break-glass production server access for an ongoing data migration.
gold_policy_passage: Maximum grant duration is 4 hours, after which credentials automatically rotate and revoke.

text: Engineer requesting break-glass access to production AWS environment without supplying a Jira ticket or incident reference.
gold_policy_passage: Temporary elevated production access (Just-In-Time access) must be requested via PAM portal with a linked incident/change ticket (Jira / ServiceNow).

text: Marketing specialist requesting access to Workday HR Admin module with approval from Direct Manager, but missing System Owner sign-off.
gold_policy_passage: Ad-hoc access to non-standard business applications requires ticketed justification, direct manager approval, and application system owner sign-off.

text: Release manager who holds production deployment authority requesting additional authority to approve their own pull requests and financial system releases.
gold_policy_passage: Dual Custody & Separation of Duties: No single individual may hold both software code deployment privileges and production release approval authority.

text: Lead backend developer requesting write and delete permissions in the production SIEM audit log cluster.
gold_policy_passage: Developers may not possess direct write or delete permissions in production logging (SIEM), audit trail repositories, or security monitoring tools.

text: Cloud architect configuring IAM root administrator access secured by FIDO2 WebAuthn Hardware Security Key (YubiKey).
gold_policy_passage: Hardware security keys (FIDO2 / WebAuthn / YubiKey) or Phishing-Resistant Authenticator Apps are mandatory for all root, cluster admin, and IAM administrator accounts.

text: System administrator requesting IAM root admin account protected solely by standard SMS-based text message OTP.
gold_policy_passage: SMS-based OTP is strictly prohibited as a standalone authentication factor for privileged access.

text: Developer pushing application source code to company Git repository containing plaintext production database credentials and AWS secret keys.
gold_policy_passage: Hardcoding API keys, database connection strings, SSH private keys, or cloud tokens into source code repositories (Git) is a critical security violation.

text: Database administrator reviewing an internal service account API key active for 115 days without rotation.
gold_policy_passage: All machine credentials and API tokens must be stored in centralized Enterprise Vaults and rotated at least every 90 calendar days.

text: Product team integrating third-party AI analysis tool to query internal data warehouse, backed by CISO security review and signed DPA.
gold_policy_passage: Granting external SaaS vendors or third-party AI integrations read-only or read-write access to internal data warehouses requires Information Security architecture review and signed Data Processing Agreements (DPA).

text: Growth team connecting external analytics SaaS to production customer data warehouse without CISO review or signed DPA.
gold_policy_passage: Granting external SaaS vendors or third-party AI integrations access to internal data warehouses requires Information Security (CISO team) architecture review and signed Data Processing Agreements (DPA).

text: Data scientist requesting read access to raw customer credit card and health records (Restricted PII) with signed Data Protection Officer (DPO) authorization.
gold_policy_passage: Restricted / Highly Sensitive (PII / PHI / Payment Card Data): Customer credit card numbers, health records. Access requires explicit Data Protection Officer (DPO) authorization and must be encrypted.

text: Intern requesting direct download access to unencrypted customer PII records without DPO approval.
gold_policy_passage: Access requires explicit Data Protection Officer (DPO) authorization and must be encrypted at rest and in transit.

text: Employee copying confidential customer databases to an unencrypted personal USB flash drive to work from home.
gold_policy_passage: Downloading customer PII or confidential enterprise databases to unencrypted USB drives, personal devices, or unauthorized external cloud storage is strictly prohibited.

text: Active full-time employee requesting read access to internal engineering wiki and public product roadmaps (Internal/Public classification).
gold_policy_passage: Internal / Confidential: Internal memos, source code, financial projections (Restricted to active employees).

text: Engineer requesting access to Snowflake reporting database with approval from Direct Manager and Snowflake System Owner.
gold_policy_passage: Ad-hoc access to non-standard business applications requires ticketed justification, direct manager approval, and application system owner sign-off.

text: Employee downloading customer PII to an unencrypted USB drive.
gold_policy_passage: Downloading customer PII or enterprise data to unencrypted USB drives or personal devices is strictly prohibited.

text: Accessing Restricted PII data without DPO authorization.
gold_policy_passage: Access to Restricted / Highly Sensitive PII/PHI data requires explicit Data Protection Officer (DPO) authorization.

text: Requesting standing direct write access to a production database.
gold_policy_passage: Direct permanent / standing read-write access to production environments is strictly prohibited.

text: Requesting break-glass access for 5 hours.
gold_policy_passage: Break-glass access duration (5 hours) exceeds maximum allowed grant of 4 hours.

text: Developer requesting both deploy and release approval authority.
gold_policy_passage: Separation of Duties violation: no single individual may hold both code deployment and production release approval authority.

text: Privileged IAM administrator account using SMS OTP for MFA.
gold_policy_passage: Privileged/IAM administrator accounts require FIDO2/Hardware Keys or Phishing-Resistant MFA; SMS OTP is prohibited.

text: API key rotation overdue at 95 days.
gold_policy_passage: API secret has not been rotated in 95 days (mandatory rotation SLA is 90 calendar days).

text: Third-party SaaS integration without signed DPA.
gold_policy_passage: Third-party SaaS/AI data warehouse integration requires CISO architecture review and signed Data Processing Agreement (DPA).

text: Accessing Restricted PII data without encryption.
gold_policy_passage: Restricted data access must be encrypted at rest and in transit.

text: Break-glass production access without an incident ticket.
gold_policy_passage: Break-glass emergency production access requires a linked incident or change ticket.

text: Developer requesting delete access to SIEM logs.
gold_policy_passage: Developers are prohibited from possessing write/delete permissions in production audit or SIEM logging repositories.

text: Non-standard application access missing system owner sign-off.
gold_policy_passage: Non-standard application access requires both direct manager approval and application system owner sign-off.
